Your role in this project is to listen to audio recordings and create accurate written transcripts of what is spoken. These transcripts will help improve AI-powered speech recognition systems.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Transcribing audio recordings into text with high accuracy
  • Capturing speech exactly as spoken, including pauses, filler words (e.g., "uh," "um"), repetitions, and incomplete sentences
  • Adding timestamps to match the audio
  • Identifying and labeling different speakers in conversations
  • Marking non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, or unclear audio

Attention to detail and strong listening skills are important to ensure high-quality transcription output.

- Excellent knowledge of and familiarity with spelling conventions in Vietnamese language.

- Can be located anywhere, but must be fluent in Vietnam dialect.

- Good reading comprehension skills in English.

- Stable internet connection.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to review examples and apply rules to the provided data.

- Prior experience with transcription.

- Prior experience with audio data.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Adding timestamps to match the audio
